decks.name: 194X
decks.note: Capcom's 194X series in release order. 1944 was developed by Eighting.
decks.author: Shmup Deck

decks.name: Aero Fighters
decks.note: Video System's Aero Fighters games, called Sonic Wings in Japan, in release order, plus Aero Fighters Special.
decks.author: Shmup Deck

decks.name: After Toaplan
decks.note: When Toaplan closed in 1994, its staff went to Cave and Raizing. This deck follows the Raizing line: Batsugun, the Raizing games, then the two games Shinobu Yagawa made after moving to Cave.
decks.author: Shmup Deck

decks.name: Black Labels
decks.note: Cave's Black Label editions: revised versions of games already in Shmup Deck.
decks.author: Shmup Deck

decks.name: Capcom
decks.note: Capcom's shooters, oldest first, from 1942 to 19XX.
decks.author: Shmup Deck

decks.name: Darius
decks.note: Taito's Darius games in release order.
decks.author: Shmup Deck

decks.name: DoDonPachi
decks.note: Every DonPachi game in Shmup Deck in release order, Black Labels included. DoDonPachi II was made by IGS, not Cave.
decks.author: Shmup Deck

decks.name: Early scrollers
decks.note: Scrolling shooters from 1981 to 1984, oldest first: Scramble and Super Cobra, the Zaxxons, Xevious and the games that followed it.
decks.author: Shmup Deck

decks.name: Easy tate
decks.note: Forgiving vertical shooters to start on while you get used to a rotated screen.
decks.author: Shmup Deck

decks.name: ESP series
decks.note: Cave's ESP games in release order: ESP Ra.De., then the two Espgaludas.
decks.author: Shmup Deck

decks.name: Every Cave game
decks.note: Cave's own shooters, oldest first. Black Labels and arrange versions left out.
decks.author: Shmup Deck

decks.name: Five steps into danmaku
decks.note: Five Cave games, each built around one idea: DonPachi's laser, DoDonPachi's chain, Dangun Feveron's speed, ESP Ra.De.'s dense bullet patterns and Ketsui's lock-on. Play them in this order.
decks.author: Shmup Deck

decks.name: Gradius and Parodius
decks.note: Konami's Gradius games and their Parodius spin-offs, in release order. Vulcan Venture is Gradius II.
decks.author: Shmup Deck

decks.name: Irem
decks.note: Irem's shooters from R-Type to In the Hunt, in release order.
decks.author: Shmup Deck

decks.name: Jaleco
decks.note: Jaleco's shooters, oldest first: the Mega System 1 games, then Mega System 32. Chimera Beast is an unreleased prototype.
decks.author: Shmup Deck

decks.name: Kaneko boards
decks.note: Shooters on Kaneko hardware, oldest first. Blaze On and Wing Force were published by Atlus, and Sand Scorpion was made by Face.
decks.author: Shmup Deck

decks.name: Konami tate
decks.note: Eight Konami verticals that turn the monitor clockwise, the other way from Cave and Toaplan. On a cab set up for those, use the core's flip option.
decks.author: Shmup Deck

decks.name: Learn to chain
decks.note: Cave's scoring systems in the order they appeared. Each game changes what a chain is, so each one is practice for the next.
decks.author: Shmup Deck

decks.name: Mushihime-Sama
decks.note: Cave's Mushihime-Sama games. Futari 1.5 is the revised version of Futari.
decks.author: Shmup Deck

decks.name: Namco
decks.note: Namco's shooters, oldest first, from Xevious to Xevious 3D/G.
decks.author: Shmup Deck

decks.name: Neo Geo shooters
decks.note: Every Neo Geo shooter in Shmup Deck, oldest first. All play on a horizontal screen.
decks.author: Shmup Deck

decks.name: Psikyo
decks.note: Psikyo's shooters from Samurai Aces to Dragon Blaze, in release order.
decks.author: Shmup Deck

decks.name: Raiden
decks.note: Seibu Kaihatsu's Raiden games in release order. Viper Phase 1 sits in its release slot because it was the first shooter on the SPI board the Raiden Fighters games used.
decks.author: Shmup Deck

decks.name: Raizing
decks.note: Raizing's shooters in release order, plus the two Eighting made for Capcom: Dimahoo and 1944.
decks.author: Shmup Deck

decks.name: Strikers 1945
decks.note: Psikyo's Strikers 1945 games. Plus is the Neo Geo game based on II.
decks.author: Shmup Deck

decks.name: Taito
decks.note: Taito's own shooters, oldest first. The Darius games also have a deck of their own.
decks.author: Shmup Deck

decks.name: Toaplan
decks.note: Toaplan's shooters by year, from Tiger Heli in 1985 to Batsugun in 1993. Twin Hawk was made by Toaplan and released by Taito.
decks.author: Shmup Deck

decks.name: TwinBee
decks.note: Konami's TwinBee arcade games in release order.
decks.author: Shmup Deck

decks.name: Two players
decks.note: Ten shooters that two people can play at the same time.
decks.author: Shmup Deck
